newsitem.title: CANADA: Pioneer Grain to build Red River elevator.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Grain to build Red River elevator.

text.p: Pioneer Grain Co Ltd said Tuesday it will begin construction shortly of a 16,000-tonne primary elevator in the Red River Valley town of Brunkild, MB.
Brunkild, 25 km (16 miles), southwest of Winnipeg, was selected because it is on a Canadian National Railway Co main line, the statement said.
The multi-million dollar facility will also sell crop inputs and offer protection services. Construction should be completed by the fall of 1997, the statement said.
Pioneer opened high throughput elevators in Glossop, MB, and Oyen, AB, last year. Two more are being built in Saskatchewan.
